gauntlet: done summary

### What is broken

Opening `/widgets/` shows page not found (404) instead of the widgets page.

### Why it is broken

The part that matches web addresses to pages compares addresses without first removing the final slash, so `/widgets/` does not match its page. A local reproduction showed the failure, and a test confirmed this cause.

### How to fix it

The fix is to remove the final slash before comparing addresses, which is expected to make `/widgets/` load. An existing ticket already tracks this problem, [widgets issue 42](https://github.com/example/widgets/issues/42). No new ticket was created, and the tracker was not changed. Follow-up on the fix continues in that ticket.
